# Migration test fixtures (Wave G, S32a/D16)

All fixtures here are **synthetic**, generated by
[`scripts/make_test_feedbucket_db.py`](../../../scripts/make_test_feedbucket_db.py)
— never a copy of a real user database, and never committed to the repo
(`*.db` is gitignored per S31).

## Canonical fixture: 3 feeds / 7 entries

| Generator command | Output |
|---|---|
| `python3 scripts/make_test_feedbucket_db.py raw <out.db>` | Raw web-schema copy (compat import path) |
| `python3 scripts/make_test_feedbucket_db.py raw <out.db> --invalid-schema` | Same, minus the `starred` table (schema-rejection fixture) |
| `python3 scripts/make_test_feedbucket_db.py package <out.db> <out-package.db>` | Raw fixture + v1 export package (preferred import path) |

Hand-computed preview counts the canonical fixture MUST produce
(pinned by `MigrationImporterTest.previewCountsExactOnCanonicalFixture`):

| Count | Value |
|---|---|
| subscriptions | 3 |
| tags | 2 |
| saved searches | 2 |
| entries | 7 |
| unread | 4 |
| starred | 2 |
| updated queue | 1 |
| recently read | 2 |
| standard actions | 1 |
| mute actions | 1 |
| entries with snapshots (`original_content IS NOT NULL`) | 2 |
| extracted entries (`extracted = 1`) | 2 |
| first subscription titles | Alpha Blog, Beta News, Gamma Lab |

The generator also inserts a `users` row with **fake** `password_hash` /
`starred_token` values so the export tool's secret gates and the importer's
secret guard are exercised against the real column names without any real
credential material (D16).

Consumers:

- `app/src/test/java/me/ash/reader/migration/MigrationImporterTest.kt`
  builds the fixture in-test via raw SQLite (`sqlite-jdbc`, test scope) and
  drives the S32a pipeline against it.
- `app/src/test/python/test_export_feedbucket_package.py` (and its JVM
  wrapper `ExportPackageToolTest.kt`) drive
  `scripts/export_feedbucket_package.py`.
